summary: Aitkin County, MN tower on Quadna Mountain near Hill City: 81-ft Aermotor ladder tower built 1929, still standing and used as an antenna mast above a former ski hill.

facts.status_note: Stands; serves as a mast for communication antennas

notes_for_editor: Build year 1929 comes from the Aitkin County survey alone; no conflicting date found. Ownership of the tower is unclear: the mountain is now a townhouse property per the association, and no source says who controls the tower or whether visitors are allowed, so no access level is recorded. Staffing and fire history not found. Design and height were not in the brief; added from the survey. Photo already in photos_manifest, so none added. Fact-check 2026-10-09: no factual errors; the townhouse page was added as evidence for the Aitkin County and Hill City location in the first sentence.
